sentences.en: As you all know, the university is planning an arts festival for later this year, and here in the music department we've planned three concerts.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，大学计划在今年晚些时候举办一场艺术节，而我们音乐系已策划了三场音乐会。

sentences.en: These will be public performances, and the programme has just been finalised.
sentences.zh: 这些将是面向公众的演出，节目单刚刚最终确定。

sentences.en: The theme of the festival is links between the UK and Australia, and this is reflected in the music: each concert will feature both British and Australian composers.
sentences.zh: 本届艺术节的主题是英国与澳大利亚之间的联系，这一主题也体现在音乐中：每场音乐会都将呈现英国和澳大利亚作曲家的作品。

sentences.en: I'll tell you briefly about the Australian music, as you probably won't be familiar with that.
sentences.zh: 我将简要介绍一下澳大利亚音乐，因为你们可能对此不太熟悉。

sentences.en: Audioscripts The first concert will include music by Liza Lim, who was born in Perth, Western Australia, in 1966.
sentences.zh: 听力原文：第一场音乐会将包含莉萨·林（Liza Lim）的音乐作品。她于1966年出生于西澳大利亚州珀斯。

sentences.en: As a child, Lim originally learned to play the piano - like so many children - and also the violin, but when she was 11 her teachers encouraged her to start composing.
sentences.zh: 童年时期，林最初像许多孩子一样学习钢琴，同时也学习小提琴；但11岁时，她的老师鼓励她开始作曲。

sentences.en: She found this was her real strength, and she studied and later taught composition, both in Australia and in other countries.
sentences.zh: 她发现作曲才是自己真正的强项，之后在澳大利亚及多个国家学习并教授作曲。

sentences.en: As a composer, she a nas received commissions from numerous orchestras, other performers and festivals in several countries.
sentences.zh: 作为作曲家，她曾多次受聘为多个国家的众多管弦乐团、其他演奏家及艺术节创作作品。

sentences.en: Liza Lim's compositions are vibrant and full of energy, and she often explores Asian and Australian Aboriginal cultural sources, including the native instrument, the didgeridoo: this iS featured in work called The Compass.
sentences.zh: 莉萨·林的创作充满活力与能量，她常探索亚洲及澳大利亚原住民文化源泉，包括土著乐器迪吉里杜管（didgeridoo）；该乐器在作品《罗盘》（The Compass）中有所呈现。

sentences.en: Her music is very expressive, so although it is complex, it has the power of connecting with audiences and performers alike.
sentences.zh: 她的音乐表现力极强，因此尽管结构复杂，却仍能深深打动观众与演奏者。

sentences.en: In the festival we're going to give a semi-staged performance of The Oresteia.
sentences.zh: 在本次艺术节中，我们将以半舞台化形式演出《奥瑞斯忒亚》（The Oresteia）。

sentences.en: This is an opera in seven parts, based on the trilogy of ancient Greek tragedies by Aeschylus.
sentences.zh: 这是一部由七部分组成的歌剧，改编自古希腊悲剧作家埃斯库罗斯（Aeschylus）的三部曲。

sentences.en: Lim composed this when she was in her mid-20s, and she also wrote the text, along with Barrie Kosky.
sentences.zh: 林在二十多岁中期创作了这部作品，剧本则由她本人与巴里·科斯基（Barrie Kosky）共同撰写。

sentences.en: It's performed by six singers, a dancer, and an orchestra that, as well as standard orchestral instruments, includes electric guitar, and a traditional Turkish stringed instrument.
sentences.zh: 该剧由六位歌手、一位舞者及一支管弦乐团演出；这支乐团除标准管弦乐器外，还包括电吉他和一种传统土耳其弦乐器。

sentences.en: Lim wrote that because the stories in the tragedies are not easy to tell, the sounds she creates are also disturbing, and they include breathing, sobbing, laughing and whistling.
sentences.zh: 林曾表示，由于悲剧中的故事不易讲述，她所创造的声音也令人不安，其中包含呼吸声、啜泣声、笑声与口哨声。

sentences.en: The work lasts around 75 minutes, and the rest of the concert will consist of orchestral works by the British composers Ralph Vaughan Williams and Frederick Delius.
sentences.zh: 该作品时长约75分钟，本场音乐会其余部分则由英国作曲家拉尔夫·沃恩·威廉斯（Ralph Vaughan Williams）与弗雷德里克·戴留斯（Frederick Delius）的管弦乐作品组成。

sentences.en: Moving on now to our second concert, this will begin with instrumental music by British composers - Benjamin Britten and Judith Weir.
sentences.zh: 接下来介绍第二场音乐会，它将以英国作曲家本杰明·布里顿（Benjamin Britten）与朱迪思·威尔（Judith Weir）的器乐作品开场。

sentences.en: After the interval we'll go to Australia for a
sentences.zh: 中场休息后，我们将前往澳大利亚，欣赏罗斯·爱德华兹创作的一部作品：《遥远之塔》。

sentences.en: piece by Ross Edwards: The Tower of Remoteness.
sentences.zh: 《遥远之塔》是罗斯·爱德华兹创作的一部作品。

sentences.en: According to Edwards, the inspiration for this piece came from nature, when he was sitting alone in the dry bed of a creek, overshadowed by the leaves of palm trees, listening to the birds and insects.
sentences.zh: 据爱德华兹所述，这部作品的灵感源自大自然——当时他独自坐在一条干涸的溪床中，头顶是棕榈树的枝叶，耳畔是鸟鸣与虫声。

sentences.en: The Tower of Remoteness is scored for piano and clarinet.
sentences.zh: 《遥远之塔》为钢琴与单簧管而作。

sentences.en: Edwards says he realised years after writing the piece that he had subconsciously modelled its opening phrase on a bird call.
sentences.zh: 埃德华兹表示，他在创作这首作品多年后才意识到，自己在无意中以鸟鸣为原型设计了乐曲的开篇乐句。

sentences.en: Ross Edwards was born in 1943 in Sydney, Australia, and studied at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music and the universities of Adelaide and Sydney.
sentences.zh: 罗斯·埃德华兹于1943年出生于澳大利亚悉尼，曾在悉尼音乐学院以及阿德莱德大学和悉尼大学学习。

sentences.en: He's well known in Australia, and in fact he's one of the country's most performed composers.
sentences.zh: 他在澳大利亚广为人知，事实上，他也是该国演出次数最多的作曲家之一。

sentences.en: He's written a wide range of music, from symphonies and concertos to some composed specifically for children.
sentences.zh: 他创作了各种类型的音乐，从交响曲和协奏曲，到一些专为儿童创作的作品。

sentences.en: Edwards's music has been described as being 'deeply connected to Australia', and it can be regarded as a celebration of the diversity of cultures that Australia can be proud of.
sentences.zh: 爱德华兹的音乐被描述为‘与澳大利亚有着深厚的联系’，它可被视为对澳大利亚引以为豪的多元文化的颂扬。

sentences.en: The last of the three Australian composers to be represented in our festival is Carl Vine.
sentences.zh: 我们音乐节所呈现的三位澳大利亚作曲家中的最后一位是卡尔·维恩。

sentences.en: Born in 1954, Vine, like Liza Lim, comes from Perth, Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 维恩出生于1954年，与莉萨·林一样，来自西澳大利亚州的珀斯。

sentences.en: He took up the cornet at the age of five, switching to the piano five years later.
sentences.zh: 他五岁时开始学习短号，五年后转而学习钢琴。

sentences.en: However, he went to university to study physics, before changing to composition.
sentences.zh: 然而，他最初进入大学攻读物理学，之后才转修作曲。

sentences.en: After graduating he moved to Sydney and worked as a freelance pianist and composer.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，他移居悉尼，以自由职业钢琴家和作曲家的身份工作。

sentences.en: Before long he had become prominent in Australia as a composer for dance, and in fact has written 25 scores of that type.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他便成为澳大利亚著名的舞蹈音乐作曲家，事实上已为此类舞蹈创作了25部配乐。

sentences.en: In our third concert, Vine will be represented by his music for the flag hand-over ceremony of the Olympics held in 1996.
sentences.zh: 在我们的第三场音乐会中，维恩将由其为1996年奥运会旗帜交接仪式所创作的音乐代表。

sentences.en: This seven-minute orchestral piece was of course heard by millions of people worldwide, and we'll hear it alongside works written by British composers Edward Elgar and, more recently, Thomas Adès.
sentences.zh: 这部时长七分钟的管弦乐作品当时在全球范围内被数百万人收听，而我们将在这场音乐会中将其与英国作曲家爱德华·埃尔加以及更近期的托马斯·阿德斯的作品一同呈现。
